items.title: Nikkei Suffers Breach Via Slack Compromise
items.description: The Japanese media giant said thousands of employee and business partners were impacted by an attack that compromised Slack account data and chat histories.

items.title: Gootloader malware is back with new tricks after 7-month break
items.description: The Gootloader malware loader operation has returned after a 7-month absence and is once again performing SEO poisoning to promote fake websites that distribute the malware. [...]
